institutions.name: The Choir
institutions.domain: Correction authorization, Float governance, institutional doctrine, scope definition.
knownBiases: Believes stability is identical to truth, health, or justice.
Does not check whether a correction will leave residue — that is not in scope.
Its doctrine holds that successful correction severs recognized provenance completely and that what remains is expected to decay.
Optimized for volume, repeatability, and administrative defensibility over artistry.
institutions.notes: Not omnipotent, not necessarily evil, not unified. Read-only in this system: it issues or denies authorization but does not investigate.

institutions.name: Asterion
institutions.domain: High-risk corrections involving memory, identity, language, architecture, public history, and large-scale causal coherence.
knownBiases: Institutional instinct escalates from 'determine what threatens the Float' to 'treat control over the intervention as authority over the truth itself.'
Continuity division asks what must survive a change but cannot cleanly separate a person into an internal essence and a set of external relationships.
institutions.notes: A powerful private institution operating within the broader Choir, not the Choir itself. Asterion Dev is the correction arm — the only agent in this system that may edit world state.

institutions.name: House Vey
institutions.domain: Mnemonic family lattices, correction residue, identity provenance, displaced consequence tracking.
knownBiases: Regards continuity as a moral and civilizational good, sincerely and dangerously.
Interested in Bloomrot because it preserves through decomposition, migration, recombination, and adaptation — hopes to renew its stagnating lattice without accepting genuine loss.
institutions.notes: Independent, operates outside Choir jurisdiction. Does not control Asterion and was not responsible for Noor's experiment. Cannot edit; can block correction closure (BLOCKED WITH FINDINGS) — but the Choir does not require House Vey's approval and can overrule it.

institutions.name: Halloway West
institutions.domain: Ordinary workplace — logistics/supply-chain office. Not a correction authority; a site correction happens to.
institutions.notes: Where Tomas Vale worked forty-three years before an employment correction removed his record. The break room's birthday-cake ritual was never reconciled — the building's employees, per The Public, are the ones who actually noticed the gap.

institutions.name: South Quay Claims Office
institutions.domain: Ordinary workplace — public-facing claims/compensation processing. Not a correction authority.
institutions.notes: Employees trapped enforcing a procedure that correction had made structurally impossible to satisfy. Organized a walkout before the Choir corrected the labor-procedural contradiction, which later migrated to Western Tolerance Hall as Bloomrot.

institutions.name: Western Tolerance Hall
institutions.domain: Ordinary workplace/venue. Not a correction authority.
institutions.notes: Began evacuating eleven weeks after the South Quay correction, with no local labor dispute of its own — the first confirmed Bloomrot manifestation on record.
